sourceWorkIndependence.actionCrossCheck: The StatPearls foot-muscle table and Lim et al. 2023 Malaysian Journal of Medical Sciences article are separately authored works in different publications. They overlap on the movement used for each named test muscle. This is a bibliographic work-level cross-check for the shared movement only, not evidence from two independent primary experiments or a complete action inventory.
sourceWorkIndependence.posteriorChapter: The 2026 StatPearls posterior-compartment chapter is a separately authored chapter in the same StatPearls series as the foot-muscle table. It is used for narrower contextual statements only and is not counted as independent primary anatomy research.

hashMeaning: sourceHash binds the source metadata row; evidenceHash binds the locator/access record; claim valueHash binds the exact saved field value. No source file or full text was downloaded, and none of these hashes is represented as a remote source-file checksum.
